If start falls on Saturday or Sunday, first move forward to following Monday. Then move forward n business days. n==0 returns start itself on weekday and following Monday on weekend, and Friday plus one business day is next Monday.

Candidate's algorithm:

```
day = start
if day.weekday() >= 5:
    day += timedelta(days=7 - day.weekday())
weeks, extra = divmod(n, 5)
day += timedelta(weeks=weeks)
if day.weekday() + extra >= 5:
    extra += 2
return day + timedelta(days=extra)
```
